product_metadata.title: Zulay Kitchen Digital Food Scale - 304 Stainless Steel Kitchen Scale - Features LCD Screen, Measures 5 Different Units Including Grams & Ounces - for Baking, Cooking, Weight Loss Keto & Meal Preps
features: Precise Measurement: Stylish and practical, with a functional design and useful high precision sensors that can weigh ingredients between 1 gram and 5 kilograms (11 pounds), consistently delivering an accurate digital scale of .01 gram accuracy making it a dependable tool that is appropriate for the professionals and to home cooks for determining ratios or servings. Package includes 2 AAA batteries.

Tare Function: "Z/T" button calculates the exact net weight of your ingredients by resetting the scale to zero, allowing you to weigh different meal prep ingredients in the same vessel without doing any calculations.

Automatic Shut-Off: This digital scale kitchen features an easy to read backlit display with a battery indicator and an auto shut-off function that activates after two minutes of inactivity to save energy.

Multipurpose Interface: Mini food scale for food ounces and grams, pounds and milliliters. Also includes a separate mode feature for weighing ML and Fl'Oz for liquids. This weight scale for food can also prompt as a baking scale, cooking scale, countertop kitchen scale or an electronic scale kitchen tool.
No Hassle, Zulay Guarantee: We back our products with a lifetime warranty.
